scope: Independent bounded source and saved-evidence review of two promoted P02 CI repairs
conclusions: Collector AST outside RunnerTests is byte-independent structurally unchanged. Production platform.platform metadata, actual host/authorization admission, source guards and cleanup ownership remain unchanged.

Fixture now mocks platform.platform while it also mocks Popen. Durable regression forces a Darwin uname and clears metadata cache, verifies the synthetic host marker, denies native protected-boot qualification and asserts no stdlib file metadata subprocess is invoked. Its before error reproduces the actual unsafe interaction.

Darwin source changes only MNT_IGNORE_OWNERS to the Apple-declared MNT_IGNORE_OWNERSHIP. fstatfs failure, nonlocal mount and ownership-ignored mount still refuse before ACL inspection. ACL validation, allow/deny rules, cleanup failure handling and ErrAccessDenied are unchanged.

primarySource.retrieval: Read through web tool during this review; no source execution.

limits: Reviewer ran no tests, compiler, native collector, CI rerun or engine call and changed no repository files.
Durable regression guards the synthetic fixture from a real stdlib probe; its repaired path intentionally does not execute that native metadata probe.
Linux C flag stubs test the predicate and declared identifier only. They do not prove Apple SDK compilation, fstatfs, ACL or mounted-volume behavior.
Native macOS compilation and permission/collector checks, unresolved ARM evidence and full P02 acceptance remain open.
decision: No concrete finding in these two bounded repairs. Source and archived component evidence support their stated narrow scope.
